# `modernize` command

Apply the automatic lint fixes in a scratch copy and keep them only when build, tests and cases show they changed
nothing.

```bash
fobis modernize [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Code quality](/cookbook/analysis).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--select` | TEXT |  | Fixable rules to apply (repeatable or comma-separated) [default: all fixable]. |
| `--apply` |  |  | Write the verified fixes into the working tree. |
| `--unverified` |  |  | With --apply: accept a build as the only check (no tests, no cases). |
| `--keep` |  |  | Keep the scratch copies (path printed). |
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--json` |  |  | Emit structured JSON to stdout instead of human-readable output (useful for scripting / agents) |

<!-- cli:end -->
